title: 3 of 5 arrested after man shot in head over $50 drug deal: MPD - NewsBreak
text:
By Melissa Moon No media credit provided. ,
4 hours ago MEMPHIS, Tenn. — Police have arrested three men and are looking for two others accused of shooting a man in the head last month over a $50 drug deal.
The victim was transported to the hospital in extremely critical condition following the shooting on Oct. 26 at a home in the 3300 block of Spottswood Avenue.
Five wanted after man critically wounded in shooting A few days after the shooting, Johnny Miller, 28, was captured by the Memphis Safe Task Force at the Super 8 Motel in West Memphis, Arkansas.
Johnny Miller, Javonte Jordan-Miller and Deangelo Yarbrough (SCSO) Javonte Jordan-Miller, 27, and Deangelo Yarbrough, 20, were also taken into custody. All three are charged with attempted first-degree murder, reckless endangerment, and possession of a weapon during a dangerous felony.
According to the affidavit of complaint, a man at the residence on Spottswood said he sold marijuana to Johnny Miller at his home earlier in the day, and there was a disagreement over the $50 price.
He said Miller threatened to come back “spraying” or shooting.
Task Force captures attempted murder suspect at West Memphis motel Investigators said Johnny Miller, Javonte Jordan-Miller, Deangelo Yarbrough, and two others were caught on a street camera walking up to the Spottswood home before the shots were fired.
The victim’s brother said one of the men knocked on the door, he opened the door and saw a gun, and ran upstairs and told his brother to get a gun.
The man said that when he came back downstairs, he found his brother in a pool of blood with a gunshot wound to the head. There is no update on the man’s condition.
